Name: 战备次数储存 / Stratagem Reserve v0.3.3
Description: 中文：支持轨道、绿战备及 7 种蓝战备，三组独立设置。单战备故障隔离、菜单重试、清理退避；不按游戏版本号拒绝，仍验证代码和布局。轨道激光每局 3 次。默认中文，可切英语，说明双语。English: Stores orbital/defense/expendable charges with per-target isolation, menu retries and cleanup backoff. Compatibility uses code/layout checks, not a game-version allowlist. Orbital Laser retains 3 mission uses. Requires Bingus Shared Loader v18 (API 1); MODS UI needs separate ModOptionsMenu API 1 / version 2+. Offline verified; v0.3.3 in-game and multiplayer testing pending.

Options.Name: 战备次数储存 / Stratagem Reserve
Options.Description: 中文：默认三组开启、上限 3、倍率 1.0X、时间继承、短冷却 5 秒。仅本机玩家；保留部署时间。English: Defaults: all groups enabled, caps 3, growth 1.0X, elapsed-seconds inheritance, short cooldown 5s. Local player only; native deployment preserved.
